name: Markie's Detector
description: Markie's Detector: records your fights (up to 4 opponents) and finds cheats - reach, killaura, aim assist, autoclicker, anti-knockback, speed, flight, auto totem, crystal aura, criticals, no slowdown, fast eat, hitboxes, step, water walk, blink - with a 3D replay, graphs and a counter coach. Also includes PvP visuals: item sizes, totem pop, end crystal style, particle control.
